tasks.build: deno run -A npm:astro build && deno run -A npm:pagefind --site dist
tasks.check: node node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs check && deno check tests/serve.ts rive/generate.ts scripts/subset-fonts.ts scripts/check-links.ts scripts/lighthouse-summary.ts && deno test --no-run tests/unit
tasks.lighthouse:desktop: rm -rf .lighthouseci lighthouse-reports/desktop && npx --yes @lhci/cli@0.15.1 collect --config=lighthouserc.desktop.json && mkdir -p lighthouse-reports/desktop && cp .lighthouseci/lhr-*.json lighthouse-reports/desktop/ && npx --yes @lhci/cli@0.15.1 assert --config=lighthouserc.desktop.json
tasks.lighthouse:mobile: rm -rf .lighthouseci lighthouse-reports/mobile && npx --yes @lhci/cli@0.15.1 collect --config=lighthouserc.mobile.json && mkdir -p lighthouse-reports/mobile && cp .lighthouseci/lhr-*.json lighthouse-reports/mobile/ && npx --yes @lhci/cli@0.15.1 assert --config=lighthouserc.mobile.json
tasks.lighthouse: deno task lighthouse:desktop ; deno task lighthouse:mobile ; deno task lighthouse:summary
